title: Machine learning-based risk prediction model for arteriovenous fistula stenosis
summary: Seven models used retrospective clinical data from 974 hemodialysis patients to predict AV-fistula stenosis; XGBoost AUC 0.829, with prospective validation still needed before clinical use. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: Seven models used retrospective clinical data from 974 hemodialysis patients to predict AV-fistula stenosis; XGBoost AUC 0.829, with prospective validation still needed before clinical use.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
